summary: Rotary Club of Mumbai North End celebrated Diwali Dil Se on 31st October at Ekta Association Garden, near RTO, Andheri West.
description: Rotary Club of Mumbai North End celebrated Diwali Dil Se on 31st October at Ekta Association Garden, near RTO, Andheri West. Grocery kits, sweet boxes and sarees were distributed to approximately 125 beneficiaries, including lady helpers and children. The initiative brought festive cheer and happiness to underprivileged families, spreading the true spirit of Diwali through sharing and caring.
